policy.rule: Every High/Medium detector must match exactly one reviewed rule at its expected count. New, removed, reclassified, or moved High/Medium findings require explicit retriage.

rules.rationale: sweep is nonReentrant; the factory-recorded curve is canonical and releaseForGraduation accepts only the configured coordinator; canonical ERC20 transfers have no supported callback into the coordinator; pre/post balances are defensive exact-transfer reconciliation.

sweep is nonReentrant; the immutable canonical FeeEscrow credit path only pulls exact USDC from an authorized creditor and verifies received amount; the balance checkpoint is a conservation postcondition, not an authorization primitive.

createPool is nonReentrant; future adapter selection is owner-controlled and snapshotted per launch; enabled adapters must match canonical USDC/locker/config; exact allowances cap spend; the malicious-adapter regression proves callback reentry is rejected while outer graduation remains valid.

the arithmetic intentionally aligns MIN_TICK/MAX_TICK to the nearest usable full-range ticks for the configured spacing; canonical Uniswap V3 fee tick spacing is positive and capped below 16384; Bread tests assert the exact full-range result for spacing 60.
available == 0 is an exact lifecycle sentinel required to distinguish an exhausted curve; it is not balance-based authentication or manipulable raw-token balance authority.
zero initialization and exact launch-timestamp equality enforce the one-call launch-buy exemption required by the ratified opening-protection policy.
zero token/timestamp checks are exact initialization sentinels for the fixed five-second opening-protection state machine.
sellableTokens() == 0 is the exact source-defined completion condition; replacing exact equality would weaken graduation correctness.
totalPending == 0 is an exact no-work sentinel before canonical fee credit; accounting conservation is covered by INV-001-006 and fee/escrow regressions.
pool identity and zero-liquidity checks are exact DEX dependency/postcondition validation; exact equality is required to reject wrong pool identity and zero liquidity.
amount == 0 deliberately avoids a zero-value FeeEscrow credit, whose canonical interface rejects zero amounts.
zero pool identity plus exact used+dust and balance-delta equalities are the INV-050-056 conservation/identity postconditions, not fragile authorization checks.
amount == 0 is an exact no-op sentinel before permanent-lock transfer and cannot authorize withdrawal or bypass locking of a positive amount.
zero and exact custody/lifecycle comparisons reject malformed swept state and enforce sufficient canonical custody before any adapter execution.
createPool is externally protected by the single OpenZeppelin nonReentrant guard; the existing malicious-adapter regression demonstrates callback rejection.
sweep is externally protected by the same OpenZeppelin nonReentrant guard; its external curve/FeeEscrow dependencies are canonical immutable/snapshotted Bread boundaries, not user-selected callbacks.
the Solidity memory struct is deliberately declared before field assignment; every EconomicsDigestInput field is explicitly assigned before abi.encode and hashing.
the adapter intentionally consumes only slot0.sqrtPriceX96 for exact initialization-price identity; the remaining slot0 values are not inputs to this validation.
